title: First split restoration phase
statement: For every natural number $k$ and Boolean words $w,s$, there is a positive integer $t\le 2|s|+|w|+5$ such that, for every $j<t$, the split-restoration machine run from its scan configuration at position $0$ is not in state $(4,\text{false})$ after $j$ steps, and after $t$ steps it is in the configuration with state $(4,\text{false})$, input head at position $1$, first work tape storing the word obtained from $s$ by appending true when $|s|\le |w|$ and leaving $s$ unchanged otherwise, all other work tapes blank, all work-tape heads at $0$, and empty output.
